footer.tagline: Reline · virtual numbers & emails for verification · payments via Korapay

hero.subtext: Rent virtual phone numbers or generate temporary email addresses for WhatsApp, Telegram, and hundreds of other services. Pay in Naira. No SIM card required.

how.heading: How it works
how.step1Body: Top up with Korapay — card, bank transfer, or USSD. Naira in, seconds later.
how.step2Body: Choose a country for a phone number, or generate a temporary email — for WhatsApp, Telegram, and hundreds more.
how.step3Body: Your code lands in your dashboard the moment it arrives. Copy it, paste it, done.
